graph.title: Batman (Brick Sketches)
notes: Booklet has one model (Batman Brick Sketch with fold-out stand). Part types use element IDs from the inventory page; IDs not in the catalogue are drafted as new types, with names and shapes inferred from the pictures.
Step images are small, so which exact stud/plate each piece sits on is approximated. Each piece is joined to the main piece it visibly rests on, but not every stud-to-stud contact is listed.
Step 6 white 4x12 plates and step 1 plate are treated as four base plates (b1, b11-b13). They are held together by the layers above, not by direct edges.
After the flip in step 22, the back-frame pieces (1x12/1x16 bricks, 1x12 plates) are modelled as studs pressed into the base plates' underside anti-studs.
Step 26 stand: red axle joiner joins the two white elbows, the two gray rods go into the elbows, and rod end caps clip to the hinge plates (b64/b65). The stand swings out (revolute).
Part 4211445 is the gray plate 1x4 and 243101 the white 1x4 tile; both exist in the catalogue. 4142865, 6047276 and 362301 are also catalogue types.
